entries.citation_caveat: Charpentier et al. (2005) is a wine-model autolysis study; I could not open the text, so the repo's anchor 'GMP 2.8 mg/g DW at 55 C, 24 h' is NOT confirmed and its units (mg/g dry weight) may not even be the units used there. Treat this as the phenomenon anchor for yeast_autolysis_kinetics and re-derive or drop the GMP number.

entries.citation_caveat: I could NOT confirm the repo's anchor 'residual nucleotides 1.5%' in this paper - the PMC full text mentions RNA reduction only qualitatively, with no percentage. The widely-reported figures are ~8-10% RNA in raw biomass reduced to <2% w/w (WHO limit) after ~68 C heat shock; a 1.5% residual is consistent with that range but is not sourced to Finnigan 2019. Treat the DOI as the process anchor, not the source of the number.

The paper reports total amino-acid nitrogen rising from 0.44 to 0.93 g/100 mL over 60 days of fermentation (~2.1x overall) and focuses on the extracellular enzyme proteome rather than individual free amino acid fold-changes. Treat the Glu/Gly multipliers as unsourced. The stored citation string 'Chambers et al. (2018)' is also wrong and should become Zhao et al. (2018).
